subject: Haven Health demo timing — hold for FY budget reset or quick tech preview?
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@havenhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@havenhealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Haven Health — pilot demo & agenda (proposed Aug 20)

Hi Marta / Jordan,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday — great to hear about the observability and cost constraints you're tracking for inference workloads. Per our call, I'd like to lock in a 45-minute pilot demo where we'll:

- show a short end-to-end flow (5–10 min) of Redwood running a real product prompt set
- surface token-level cost/latency breakdowns and routing examples
- walk through Dedicated vs. Hosted tradeoffs for regulated PHI-ish workloads
- discuss next steps (PO timing / MAP / procurement)

Proposed slot: Friday Aug 20, 11:00–11:45 PT. If that doesn't work, I can also do Aug 26 in the same window.

I've attached the current deck and a draft mutual action plan so you can share with finance/ops: [Attachment: demo-deck-v2.pdf (15KB, PDF)], [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (18KB, XLSX)].

If finance is likely to be locked down for the month, happy to pivot — quick question: is your CFOxpected to be out at the end of August for travel? If so we can either a) do a short technical preview for Eng earlier (reduced scope) or b) hold until your FY budget reset in early September per your planning cadence.

Who else from procurement/infosec should we include?

Cheers,
Dev
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: demo-deck-v2.pdf], [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@havenhealth.com>

Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@havenhealth.com>, finance-leads@havenhealth.com
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Haven Health — pilot demo & agenda (proposed Aug 20)

Hi Dev,

Thanks — the agenda looks good. Two things to flag: the CFO is scheduled to be in Europe for most of the last two weeks of August (travel + external audits), and Finance has a temporary spend freeze while they complete the FY reset (expected complete around Sep 6). Given that, the exec and procurement decision-makers won't be available to sign off until after the reset.

We have two preferences:
1) Hold the full demo until after Sep 6 so we can get the CFO and procurement in one session (preferred).
2) If Redwood prefers, we could do a short technical preview (no pricing or commercial discussion) with Eng and SRE the week of Aug 23 — that would help us validate integration assumptions but won't accelerate procurement.

If you can send a high-level preliminary cost estimate and the MAP we can circulate to Finance so they have visibility coming out of the freeze. Procurement lead is Melissa Cho (melissa.cho@havenhealth.com).

--
Marta Ruiz
VP, Platform Engineering | Haven Health
M: +1 (617) 555-4099

Hi Marta / Jordan,

Appreciate the heads up on the CFO travel and finance freeze — totally makes sense to avoid a full commercial session while procurement is locked. Two quick thoughts from my side:

- If youwant to keep momentum we can run a "technical preview" for Eng/SRE on Tue Aug 24 or Thu Aug 26 (30 min). We'll focus purely on integration (networking, VPC, KMS options, latency expectations) and avoid cost/pricing.
- Otherwise we can tentatively hold a full demo + procurement Q&A the week of Sep 6. I propose we put a soft hold on Thu Sep 9, 11:00–11:45 PT and I'll update the invite to include Melissa Cho and Finance once the freeze lifts.

I'll prepare a short one-pager cost estimate (ballpark model run costs, committed vs. on-demand math) and post it to the HubSpot record so procurement can see it while the freeze completes.

If you prefer the preview, say which date works and Dev will send a calendar invite + stripped deck.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

We're happy to do either. If Finance wants everything paused until after Sep 6, we'll set the soft hold and send over the requested materials so procurement has something to review right after their reset. If you want the Aug 24/26 preview for Eng, we can run that as a short no-cost technical session (hands-on, 30 min).

I'll attach:
- a concise cost-estimate one-pager [Attachment: cost-estimate-onepager.pdf]
- an updated, stripped demo deck for Eng only (no pricing slides)
- a cleaned MAP with milestones and procurement touchpoints

Can you confirm procurement contact (Melissa) and whether Melissa should be on the Sep 9 soft-hold invite?

If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I'll go ahead and place a soft hold for Thu Sep 9, 11:00–11:45 PT and upload the MAP to the HubSpot record.

— Dev
